newsitem.title: CHINA: China to focus on securities, futures supervision.
newsitem.headline: China to focus on securities, futures supervision.

text.p: China's top securities watchdog said that supervision was a priority in curbing widespread irregularities in the securities and futures market, the Shanghai Securities News said on Friday.

"Currently, there are still many problems on the markets including institutions illegally borrowing money for speculation and wealthy individuals colluding to manipulate prices," Zhou Daojiong, chairman of the China Securities Regulatory Commission was quoted by the newspaper as saying.
"In particular, excessive speculation is a problem," Zhou told officials of provincial securities supervisory commissions at a meeting in Beijing this month.
He urged the officials to strictly implement regulations and deal with irregularities to protect the interests of small investors.
